title: Fixing the Mackinaw
summary: Panam is under the Mackinaw at a Jackson Plains garage and calls for parts by name. V hands them over.
description: The Mackinaw is making a noise, so Panam is under it on a creeper at a Jackson Plains garage. She calls for parts by name and wants V to hand them over.

start.bringUp: The Mackinaw is making a noise. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to come to the Jackson Plains garage, hand you things and pretend to know what they are.

variations.know: The noise is the front brakes, and Panam is sure of it.
variations.wants: V to hand over the brake parts by name.

variations.know: The noise is a loose belt, and Panam is grumpy about the parts list.
variations.wants: V to find the belt and the tensioner.

variations.know: The noise is the radio rattling in the dash, and Panam admits it is not the truck.
variations.wants: V to fix the radio mount and keep quiet about it.

garage.name: the Jackson Plains gas station garage, where the Mackinaw is on the lift

crate-a.name: the first marked parts crate in the garage

crate-b.name: the second marked parts crate in the garage

crate-c.name: the third marked parts crate in the garage

g1.asks: What was the first car you ever drove?
g1.know: Panam is under the Mackinaw and V is handing her parts. She calls each one by name.
g1.secret: She remembers what V says and will tease V with it later.
g1.wants: The next part, and V's answer.

stages.label: Panam works under the Mackinaw and calls for parts by name
stages.objective: Hand Panam the parts she calls for at the Jackson Plains garage
stages.know: V is at the Jackson Plains garage. Panam is under the Mackinaw on the creeper and calls for parts by name.
stages.wants: V to bring her the parts she calls for.

fixed.memory: You handed Panam the parts for the Mackinaw until the noise was gone.
